lines.1: As a rule, our class has a lot of problem children.
lines.2: Discipline is nonexistent, and until the teacher arrives, everyone is out of their seat doing whatever they please.
lines.3: You might wonder why a class with the Student Council President has so little discipline. It's because the president herself does whatever she pleases.
lines.4: 「Everyone, if you make too much noise, you'll bother the other classes.」
lines.7: This is a class where anyone with common sense has a hard life.
lines.8: Since no one would listen, the class representative, Yoshimi Sato, trudged back to filling out the class log.
lines.10: 「Oh, I dropped my mechanical pencil... Um... Where did it go?」
lines.12: I'm used to seeing Crab like this, so it does nothing for me, but this was something else.
lines.13: This class rep can be oddly defenseless.
lines.14: I feel like I see her panties all the time.
lines.15: Everyone else insists, 'No one gets that lucky,' but that has to be a lie.
lines.17: Our midterm results were being handed back one after another.
